title: Christmas Dinner
subtitle: Example plan: prime rib dinner for 8 at 16:00

tasks.title: Dry-brine the prime rib
tasks.details: **Dry-brine the prime rib:** pat dry, rub all over with kosher salt, and set it on a rack over a tray, **uncovered**, in the fridge until Christmas morning.

tasks.title: Make the chocolate mousse
tasks.details: Make the chocolate mousse, spoon into glasses, cover, and chill overnight.

tasks.title: Boil the potatoes
tasks.details: Peel and cut the potatoes; cover with cold salted water and boil until fork-tender.

tasks.title: Mash potatoes · stove off
tasks.details: Drain, steam-dry, mash with butter, cream cheese and cream. Into the buttered slow-cooker insert, cover, fridge. **Stove off.**

tasks.title: Bedtime fridge check
tasks.details: **Bedtime fridge check:** rib uncovered on its rack; mousse and potatoes covered; green beans trimmed and bagged; stock and rolls ready.

tasks.title: Prime rib out of the fridge
tasks.details: **Prime rib out of the fridge** to come up to room temperature (about 2 hr). Do not salt again. Tie it if it is not already tied.

tasks.title: Oven to 225°F
tasks.details: Oven to **225°F**, rack in the lower-middle position.

tasks.title: Prime rib into the oven
tasks.details: **Prime rib into the 225°F oven**, fat side up, probe in the center, not touching bone. Roast until **120°F** (about 3 hr).

tasks.title: Mashed potatoes into the slow cooker
tasks.details: Mashed potatoes into the slow cooker on **LOW** with 2 tbsp butter on top.

tasks.title: Stir the mashed potatoes
tasks.details: **Repeat every 30 min:** stir the potatoes; add warm cream if stiff.

tasks.title: Start the au jus
tasks.details: Simmer the stock with the onion, carrot and thyme; keep it at a gentle simmer.

tasks.title: Check the prime rib temp
tasks.details: Check the rib: **pull at 120°F** in the center. If it is early, leave the oven door shut; if it is slow, see Problems.

tasks.title: Prime rib OUT · oven to 425°F · beans in
tasks.details: **Prime rib OUT** at 120°F. Tent loosely with foil and rest **40 min**; save the drippings for the jus. Oven up to **425°F**; green beans in, 25 min.

tasks.title: Beans out · rolls in
tasks.details: Green beans out, tent to keep warm. **Rolls in**, about 8 min.

tasks.title: Rolls out · oven to 500°F
tasks.details: Rolls out and into a towel-lined basket. Oven to **500°F** for the sear.

tasks.title: Prime rib back in to sear
tasks.details: **Sear:** prime rib back into the 500°F oven for 8 min, until the crust is deep brown.

tasks.title: Rib out · oven off
tasks.details: **Prime rib out. Oven off.** Rest 10 min before carving.

tasks.title: Carve the prime rib
tasks.details: Whisk the drippings into the jus and strain. Carve the rib: cut the bones off, then slice across the grain.

tasks.title: To the table · stove and slow cooker off
tasks.details: Jus into a warm pitcher, potatoes to the table. **Slow cooker and stove off.**

tasks.title: Dinner! 🎄
tasks.details: **Dinner is served.**

tasks.title: Dessert out of the fridge
tasks.details: Chocolate mousse out of the fridge.

tasks.title: Leftovers into the fridge
tasks.details: Leftovers into the fridge (food safety: within about 2 hr).

recipes.name: Reverse-sear prime rib
ingredients: 1 bone-in prime rib roast, about 10 lb
steps: Pat dry and rub all over with the salt; rest on a rack, **uncovered**, in the fridge.
Out of the fridge about 2 hr before roasting.
Rub with the pepper, garlic, butter and rosemary.
Roast at 225°F until the center reads **120°F** (about 3 hr).
Tent and rest 40 min.
Oven to 500°F; sear 8 min until browned. Rest 10 min and carve.
notes: Go by the probe, not the clock.

recipes.name: Au jus
steps: Simmer the stock with the onion, carrot and thyme for about an hour.
Whisk in the rib drippings (a little at a time, tasting; they are salty).
Strain, season, and keep warm.

recipes.name: Make-ahead mashed potatoes
recipes.when: Make Dec 24; slow cooker Dec 25 from 13:00
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water until fork-tender; drain and steam-dry.
Mash with the butter, cream cheese and cream; season.
Spread in a buttered slow-cooker insert; refrigerate.
**Dec 25:** LOW from 13:00 with 2 tbsp butter on top; stir every 30 min.

recipes.name: Roasted green beans
steps: Toss the beans with the oil and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast at 425°F for 25 min, stirring once.
Top with the almonds and lemon zest.

recipes.name: Dinner rolls
ingredients: 16 brown-and-serve dinner rolls (or your own dough, shaped)
steps: Brush with the butter.
Bake at 425°F for about 8 min until golden.
Wrap in a towel-lined basket to keep warm.

recipes.name: No-bake chocolate mousse
steps: Heat ½ cup of the cream; pour over the chocolate; stir smooth; cool.
Whip the remaining cream with the sugar, vanilla and salt to soft peaks.
Fold into the chocolate; spoon into glasses; cover; chill overnight.

fallbacks.title: Roast running fast or slow
body: Go by the probe, not the clock. Pull the rib at 120°F in the center, even if that is early or late.
The oven steps after it (beans, rolls, sear) move together; shift the oven lane to keep them in order.

probeTargets.label: Prime rib: pull from the oven
probeTargets.note: Carryover plus the sear takes it to about 130°F (medium-rare). Verify against current food-safety guidance; USDA lists 145°F as the safe minimum for whole cuts of beef.

setupChecklist: Plug in the laptop and turn the volume up.
